title: Decoherence-controlled collective criticality in a two-dimensional quantum Stag Hunt
summary: Physical decoherence can preserve the microscopic strategic neutrality (i.e. zero effective field and equal potential of the two homogeneous strategic orientations) of a quantum game while changing the thermodynamic regime of the corresponding interacting population. We demonstrate this for an Eisert--Wilkens--Lewenstein (\textit{EWL}) Stag Hunt embedded as independent nearest neighbor encounters on a square lattice.
